strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Consumes approved remote candidate state into active Mode Pack policy under Rust authority.
Recompiles and revalidates cached approved candidate policy before active replacement.
Records bounded active replacement and candidate consumption evidence without raw candidate JSON.
Lets scheduled callers complete remote Mode Pack lifecycle from fetch to approval to active policy without manual workspace edits.

answers.strategic_capabilities: mode_pack_runtime with support from runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: modepack.replaceActive can activate one approved cached remote candidate and consume its approval after verified active replacement.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M38.1 only caches remote bytes, M38.2 only approves trust eligibility, and existing local replacement does not require approved-candidate evidence or consume approval state.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Remote Mode Packs remain fetched and approved but cannot become active runtime policy without manual workspace edits or implicit trust.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M38.2 approval, M38.1 fetch/cache, and M37.2 rollback because it mutates active policy from approved remote candidate evidence.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends the existing modepack.replaceActive authority instead of adding a parallel activation endpoint.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds bounded execution evidence fields, not a report, digest, history, readiness, preview, or inspection surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime can revalidate an approved cached candidate, replace active Mode Pack policy from it, consume the approval, and replay the result idempotently.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can complete external Mode Pack activation from bounded fingerprints and approval IDs without raw cache inspection.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the planned M38 path from remote acquisition to trust approval to active runtime policy.

exit_criteria: modepack.replaceActive accepts approved candidate evidence without adding a new replacement RPC
approved candidate activation requires explicit authorization and current active fingerprint
approved candidate approval id, content sha256, compiled policy fingerprint, and activation fingerprint are revalidated
cached candidate bytes are re-read and recompiled before active replacement
successful activation replaces active Mode Pack state and marks approved candidate consumed only after verification
replay returns existing replacement and consumption evidence without duplicate events
denials leave active state unchanged and approval unconsumed
new task mode resolution can use a mode from the activated remote candidate
RPC and ledger payloads contain bounded metadata only and no raw Mode Pack JSON or raw candidate content
Behavior tests cover activation/replay, denial or consumed-state handling, bounded output, and VSIX validation

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M38.3 changes runtime/protocol/store/VSIX behavior and phase manifests; review must confirm this is active policy mutation from approved candidate evidence, not a wrapper surface.
